cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0)

# Performance comparison: every implementation of every CGO kernel over a size sweep.
# src/main.c is generated by scripts/gen_perf_compare.py and embeds every
# variant's source, so nothing links against XNNPACK.
set(CONF_FILE prj.conf riscv_vector.conf)

find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{ZEPHYR_BASE})
project(perf_compare)

target_sources(app PRIVATE src/main.c)
target_include_directories(app PRIVATE src)   # neon2rvv.h

# -march comes from Kconfig (V + Zvfh in riscv_vector.conf); passing it here
# would override Zephyr's and drop Zvfh. The autovec sections re-enable GCC's
# vectorizer per block with #pragma GCC optimize, as Zephyr builds with it off.
target_compile_options(app PRIVATE -O3)

# Zephyr's int64_t/uint64_t are `long long`; the RVV intrinsics take `long`. Both are 64 bits on
# rv64, but GCC 14 makes the pointer mismatch in neon2rvv.h's 64-bit load/store wrappers an error.
target_compile_options(app PRIVATE -Wno-error=incompatible-pointer-types)

# The SIMDe lane (gen_perf_compare.py --simde): SIMDe's headers, and fixed-length RVV types (VLEN from the -march
# zvl*b, which the build must then carry) so that SIMDe takes its RVV implementations instead of portable C.
if(DEFINED SIMDE_INCLUDE)
  if(NOT DEFINED SIMDE_VLEN)
    set(SIMDE_VLEN 512)
  endif()
  if(NOT riscv_march)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "SIMDe build: Zephyr's riscv_march is not visible here")
  endif()
  target_include_directories(app PRIVATE ${SIMDE_INCLUDE})
  # SIMDE_MODE rvv (default): fixed-length RVV types, so SIMDe takes its RVV implementations (SIMDE_RISCV_V_NATIVE).
  # SIMDe sizes those types to the whole VLEN (its Neon types' member is `sv128`; NATURAL_VECTOR_SIZE is fixed at 128),
  # so at VLEN 512 some kernels break. SIMDE_MODE portable: no fixed VLEN, SIMDe's portable C (GCC vector
  # extensions, which GCC lowers to RVV).
  if(NOT DEFINED SIMDE_MODE)
    set(SIMDE_MODE rvv)
  endif()
  if(SIMDE_MODE STREQUAL "rvv")
    set(simde_flags -march=${riscv_march}_zvl${SIMDE_VLEN}b -mrvv-vector-bits=zvl)
  else()
    set(simde_flags -march=${riscv_march}_zvl${SIMDE_VLEN}b)
  endif()
  # Zephyr's own -march with the vector length added (the last -march wins for the app's sources)
  target_compile_options(app PRIVATE ${simde_flags})
  message(STATUS "SIMDe lane (${SIMDE_MODE}): ${SIMDE_INCLUDE}, ${simde_flags}")
endif()
